title: FoTeams
description: GUI-first teams with roles, warps, shared storage, Vault upgrades, and optional FoLevels team XP.
body:
![Cover Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0e0c7d05a1bb335683562d53c282cbff85fdfedd.png)
**Give players polished team management with roles, warps, shared storage, relations, chat, upgrades, and optional team leveling.**

FoTeams is a team plugin built around an in-game GUI, while still keeping command access for fast workflows. It is designed for survival, economy, SMP, and competitive servers that need team homes, shared storage, permissions, bank upgrades, ally chat, and admin controls without making players memorize every command.

![FoTeams dashboard with team info, members, warps, chat, shared chest, and upgrades](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/45664154674b23ccc8395f590b303c2d2afc86af.png)

## Features

- Create teams, invite players, manage pending invites, and handle joins from commands or GUI.
- Manage roles with configurable owner, admin, and member permissions.
- Use native Paper dialog inputs when the server supports them, with inventory and chat fallbacks for other servers.
- Set a team home and multiple team warps, including optional warp passwords.
- Use a shared team ender chest with configurable and upgradeable row limits.
- Toggle team PvP protection and manage alliances through team relations.
- Use team chat, ally chat, and admin chat spy for moderation.
- Add Vault-powered team banks, deposits, withdrawals, balance tops, and paid upgrades.
- Enable optional FoLevels-based team XP, level progress, top rankings, and level rewards.
- Register PlaceholderAPI placeholders for team, role, balance, score, and level data.

![Team settings GUI with members, warps, relations, shared chest, upgrades, and PvP protection](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c8b4fb1de11a56ae16e8821c53a0d019cea6e4ea.png)

![Team upgrades GUI for member slots and shared chest rows](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fb2ccefeda46a71457a87aa104cabcb65ca15b91.png)

![Admin team browser or editor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b7e62f42567bcc16712edfb4413301b571faef79.png)

## Dependencies

- **Optional:** Vault for team banks, deposits, withdrawals, balance tops, and paid upgrades.
- **Optional:** FoLevels for team XP and team levels.
- **Optional:** PlaceholderAPI for placeholders.
- Uses SQLite storage by default; no external database is required.

## Commands

- `/team` - Open the team dashboard.
- `/team create <name>` - Create a team.
- `/team invite <player>` - Invite a player.
- `/team join <team>` - Join a team you were invited to.
- `/team leave` - Leave your team.
- `/team disband` - Disband your team.
- `/team kick <player>` - Remove a member or admin.
- `/team promote <player>` and `/team demote <player>` - Manage member roles.
- `/team pvp [on|off]` - Toggle team PvP protection.
- `/team ally <team>` and `/team unally <team>` - Manage alliances.
- `/team chat [message]` and `/team allychat [message]` - Use team or ally chat.
- `/team sethome`, `/team home`, `/team setwarp <name> [password]`, `/team warp <name> [password]` - Manage team travel.
- `/team info [team]` - View public team info.
- `/team upgrades` - Open team upgrades.
- `/team level [top]` - View team level progress or top teams.
- `/team bal`, `/team baltop`, `/team deposit <amount>`, `/team withdraw <amount>` - Use team economy features.
- `/teamadmin editor [team]` - Open the admin team browser or editor.
- `/teamadmin reload` - Reload configs.
- `/teamadmin version` - Show plugin version.
- `/teamadmin chatspy` - Toggle team chat spy.

## Permissions

- `foteams.use` - Access player commands.
- `foteams.admin` - Access admin commands and admin GUI tools.

## Placeholders
- `%foteams_team_name%` - Player's team name.
- `%foteams_team_tag%` - Player's team tag.
- `%foteams_team_colour%` - Player's team tag color.
- `%foteams_team_description%` - Player's team description.
- `%foteams_team_score%` - Player's team score.
- `%foteams_team_score_rank%` - Player's team score rank.
- `%foteams_team_balance%` - Player's formatted team balance.
- `%foteams_team_balance_rank%` - Player's team balance rank.
- `%foteams_team_level%` - Player's team level.
- `%foteams_team_level_xp%` - Player's current team XP.
- `%foteams_team_level_required_xp%` - XP required for the team's current level progress.
- `%foteams_team_level_remaining_xp%` - Remaining XP needed for the next team level.
- `%foteams_team_level_progress_percent%` - Team level progress as a rounded percent.
- `%foteams_team_level_rank%` - Player's team level rank.
- `%foteams_team_role%` - Player's role in their team.
- `%foteams_team_member_count%` - Current team member count.
- `%foteams_team_member_cap%` - Current team member cap.
- `%foteams_team_owner%` - Team owner's player name.
